title: Authorizations to Modify Bulk, Parking, Grading and Private Roads Regulations

blocks.html: For a development, enlargement or site alteration located within the Special Natural Area District, the City Planning Commission may authorize:
blocks.plainText: For a development, enlargement or site alteration located within the Special Natural Area District, the City Planning Commission may authorize:

blocks.html: (a)        modification of lot coverage controls in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-431;
blocks.plainText: (a) modification of lot coverage controls in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-431;

blocks.html: (b)        modification of underlying district regulations relating to bulk or parking in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-432 (Modification of yard, height and setback regulations, and parking location regulations);
blocks.plainText: (b) modification of underlying district regulations relating to bulk or parking in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-432 (Modification of yard, height and setback regulations, and parking location regulations);

blocks.html: (c)        modification of grading controls in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-433; and
blocks.plainText: (c) modification of grading controls in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-433; and

blocks.html: (d)        modification of requirements for driveways and private roads on Tier I sites and Tier II sites in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-434.
blocks.plainText: (d) modification of requirements for driveways and private roads on Tier I sites and Tier II sites in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-434.

subsections.plainText: (a) modification of lot coverage controls in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-431;

subsections.plainText: (d) modification of requirements for driveways and private roads on Tier I sites and Tier II sites in accordance with the provisions of Section 105-434.
